ru_sync.skuMap.page.title: RU SKU map
ru_sync.skuMap.page.description: RU codes and the product each one resolves to: {mapped} of {total} mapped. An unmapped code is never merged silently and blocks the purchase-order draft.
ru_sync.skuMap.list.searchPlaceholder: Search by RU code, product SKU or name
ru_sync.skuMap.actions.ignoreConfirmBody: Ignoring means the code will never be mapped (discontinued or a typing mistake). It leaves the pending list but stays visible here and can be restored.
ru_sync.skuMap.bind.title: Bind a RU code to a product
ru_sync.skuMap.bind.description: Pick the product {code} refers to. A bound code can be used by the purchase-order draft and the margin figures.
ru_sync.skuMap.loadFailed: Could not load the mapping list
ru_sync.health.page.title: RU sync health
ru_sync.health.page.description: Per endpoint: the snapshot date, the cursor position and the last pull's outcome. A cursor that has not advanced within the threshold marks the data stale.
ru_sync.health.loadFailed: Could not load the sync health
ru_sync.health.alert.stale: A cursor has not advanced for more than {hours} hours: the cockpit marks the data stale, so do not decide on the old numbers.
ru_sync.notifications.pullFailed.title: RU data pull failed
ru_sync.notifications.pullFailed.body: An endpoint pull failed and its cursor did not advance; the cockpit data may be one batch behind.
